stories.sz: 西澳地区法院听取了《贾斯珀·琼斯》作者发送多条表达对幼男产生性欲望的信息的情况。警告：本文包含大尺度内容。获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客……

stories.t: US: 9 killed in Florida jet crash
stories.s: A Learjet plane crashed near a busy road in a residential neighborhood in Palm Beach County, leaving all nine people on board dead and a large crater on ground.
stories.tz: 美国：佛罗里达州飞机坠毁致9人死亡
stories.sz: 一架里尔喷气机（Learjet）在棕榈滩县一处居民区靠近繁忙道路的地方坠毁，导致机上9人全部遇难，并在地面留下一个大弹坑。

stories.t: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
stories.s: The exchange froze transactions following the incident which has been linked to a North Korean group.
stories.tz: 币安用户在遭遇史上最大规模加密货币黑客攻击后提取36亿美元
stories.sz: 在发生与朝鲜黑客团伙有关联的安全事件后，该加密货币交易所冻结了交易。

stories.t: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
stories.s: The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.
stories.tz: 联合国在争议地区西撒哈拉的维和使命在持续35年后结束
stories.sz: 联合国针对争议地区西撒哈拉长期进行的维和使命于周日停止运作，历时35年。该地区曾由西班牙统治，摩洛哥和主张独立的“萨基亚姆拉和里奥德奥罗人民阵线”（波利萨里奥阵线）均声称对该地区拥有主权。

stories.sz: 在中东战事与房价暴跌交织的背景下，预计澳大利亚央行周二将再度向房贷持有人施压。获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客……澳大利亚经济正面临“更剧烈……”

stories.t: 'I couldn't be silent': Iranian teen's mother seeking justice after daughter shot dead
stories.s: BBC Panorama follows grieving Samira who - after the killing of Sevda - faces up to the Tehran regime.
stories.tz: “我无法保持沉默”：伊朗少女遭枪杀后，母亲踏上寻求正义之路
stories.sz: BBC全景栏目（Panorama）跟踪报道了悲痛的萨米拉（Samira）。在女儿塞夫达（Sevda）遇害后，她选择直面德黑兰政权。

stories.t: Iran killed her teenage daughter - now she is facing up to the regime
stories.s: Samira's 16-year-old daughter Sevda was shot dead as they took part in mass protests in January.
stories.tz: 伊朗杀害了她的teenage女儿——如今她正直面政权
stories.sz: 萨米拉16岁的女儿塞夫达在1月参加大规模抗议活动时遭枪击身亡。

stories.t: Most Israelis think settlements policy should change to avoid more sanctions, poll finds
stories.s: Survey finds UK government’s decision to impose trade ban was not a decisive factor in how Israelis voted in election The UK government’s decision to impose a ban on trade in goods from illegal settlements was not decisive in how Israelis…
stories.tz: 民调显示多数以色列人认为应改变定居点政策以避免更多制裁
stories.sz: 调查显示，英国政府实施贸易禁令的决定并非以色列人在选举中投票的决定性因素。英国政府决定对非法定居点的商品实施贸易禁令，这并未对以色列人的投票产生决定性影响……

stories.t: Israel has ‘historic’ opportunity to change direction, says leader of Arab coalition
stories.s: Yousef Jabareen says he is ready to join forces with opposition bloc to oust Benjamin Netanyahu after winning record number of seats in Knesset The leader of Israel’s main Palestinian coalition, which holds the balance of power after…
stories.tz: 阿拉伯政党联盟领导人称以色列迎来改变方向的“历史性”机遇
stories.sz: 优素福·贾巴林（Yousef Jabareen）在议会（Knesset）赢得创纪录席位后表示，他准备与反对派阵营联手罢免本杰明·内塔尼亚胡。作为以色列主要巴勒斯坦人联盟的领导人，他在大选中掌握着平衡权……

stories.t: China state broadcaster pulls La Liga matches following Mbappé joke
stories.s: China Media Group, which acknowledged Mbappé's apology, has not said how long the blackout will last.
stories.tz: 中国国家广播电视台因姆巴佩言论撤播西甲比赛
stories.sz: 已承认姆巴佩道歉的中央广播电视总台尚未说明黑屏停播将持续多久。

stories.t: King to address slavery in Antigua as PM says he is open to possible UK apology
stories.s: King Charles III will deliver a speech to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting on Tuesday as he concludes his nine-day Caribbean tour.
stories.tz: 英国国王将在安提瓜谈及奴隶制，首相称对英国可能道歉持开放态度
stories.sz: 英国国王查尔斯三世在结束为期九天的加勒比海访问行程之际，将于周二在英联邦政府首脑会议上发表讲话。

stories.t: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
stories.s: There were hundreds of arrests as protesters took to the streets in cities across France for the third weekend in a row.
stories.tz: 法国在警察遭遇汽油弹袭击后展开谋杀未遂调查
stories.sz: 抗议者连续第三个周末走上法国各大城市的街头，数百人被捕。

stories.t: Judge dismisses Trump administration's lawsuit over two Dan Sullivans in Alaska election
stories.s: The Department of Justice had sought to delay certifying results in Alaska's crucial Senate race if the Republican incumbent loses.
stories.tz: 法官驳回特朗普政府就阿拉斯加州选举中两名“丹·沙利文”同名问题提起的诉讼
stories.sz: 若共和党现任议员落败，美国司法部曾试图推迟认证阿拉斯加州关键参议员竞选的结果。

stories.t: UK was ‘vehement’ slavery reparations should not be on Commonwealth summit agenda
stories.s: British prime minister has now agreed to structured dialogue on reparatory justice but issue remains off formal Chogm agenda British officials reportedly insisted that discussions of reparations for slavery should not be on the agenda of…
stories.tz: 英国曾“强烈坚信”奴隶制赔偿不应列入英联邦峰会议程
stories.sz: 英国首相现已同意就补偿性正义展开结构性对话，但该议题仍未列入英联邦政府首脑会议（Chogm）的正式议程。据报道，英国官员坚称关于奴隶制赔偿的讨论不应列入……

stories.t: Gulf region on edge as Qatar leads talks with Iran to stave off new U.S. attacks
stories.s: Qatar has been leading intense mediation efforts over the past 72 hours to prevent a new round of possible U.S. attacks on Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections. The uncertainty has the entire Gulf region on edge.
stories.tz: 卡塔尔主导与伊朗会谈以阻止美国新一轮袭击，海湾地区神经紧绷
stories.sz: 在周二的中期选举之后，为防止美国对伊朗发动新一轮可能的袭击，卡塔尔在过去72小时内主导了密集的斡旋努力。这种不确定性令整个海湾地区神经紧绷。

stories.t: Russia's giant new radar in Kaliningrad raises alarm in NATO
stories.s: Russia is nearing completion of what experts think is a giant radar complex in Kaliningrad, capable of monitoring much of Europe. Experts warn the project could intensify the military standoff between Moscow and NATO.
stories.tz: 俄罗斯在加里宁格勒新建的巨型雷达引发北约警惕
stories.sz: 俄罗斯即将完成专家所称的位于加里宁格勒的巨型雷达综合设施，该设施能够监测欧洲大部分地区。专家警告称，该项目可能会加剧莫斯科与北约之间的军事对峙。

stories.t: Peaceful protests in Germany spiral into violence and looting
stories.s: Thousands joined largely orderly demonstrations earlier in the day, before violence erupted in Frankfurt, Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg.
stories.tz: 德国和平抗议活动演变成暴力和打砸抢
stories.sz: 当天早些时候，数千人参加了大多秩序井然的示威活动，随后暴力事件在法兰克福、柏林、科隆和汉堡爆发。

stories.t: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
stories.s: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.
stories.tz: 邦迪海滩袭击事件后 悉尼武装警察开始巡逻
stories.sz: 新组建的警察部队是一项安全举措，旨在应对去年光明节期间发生的致命枪击袭击事件。

stories.sz: 在卡塔尔试图通过谈判解冻60亿美元伊朗资产以促成该水道重新开放之际，间接谈判进入第三天。海湾国家官员在等待华盛顿对……的回应时“做好了最坏的打算”。

stories.t: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
stories.s: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.
stories.tz: 医院称以军空袭加沙致包括一名儿童在内的8人死亡
stories.sz: 官员称，哈马斯控制的警察部门有5名警员在汗尤尼斯身亡，另有3人（含一名儿童）在加沙城丧生。

stories.t: University of Cambridge scientist among those who died in Spanish train crash
stories.s: Marta Shahbazi was an "inspiring, talented and passionate scientist", says the laboratory where she worked.
stories.tz: 剑桥大学科学家在西班牙列车脱轨事故中遇难
stories.sz: 玛尔塔·沙巴齐被其工作的实验室称为“一位具有启发性、才华横溢且充满激情的科学家”。

stories.t: Tens of thousands protest against Narendra Modi regime in Delhi
stories.s: Led by Congress party, India’s opposition alliance channels anger over removal of 130 million names from voter roll Thousands of opposition supporters have gathered in Delhi as protests against the Narendra Modi government continue to…
stories.tz: 数万人在德里集会抗议纳伦德拉·莫迪政权
stories.sz: 在国大党领导下，印度反对派联盟就1.3亿选民被除名一事掀起抗议怒潮。随着针对纳伦德拉·莫迪政府的抗议持续，数千名反对派支持者聚集在德里。

stories.t: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
stories.s: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.
stories.tz: 加密货币公司币安在发生63亿美元黑客攻击后承担了90%的损失
stories.sz: 美国联邦调查局（FBI）表示，朝鲜应对此次黑客攻击负责。

stories.t: Ethnic Germans in Kazakhstan face legacy of the Soviet Union
stories.s: Kazakhstan is struggling to deal with the legacy of the Soviet dictatorship. Some 85 years ago, Stalin deported hundreds of thousands of people: Some 400,000 ethnic Germans living in the USSR were sent to Kazakhstan.
stories.tz: 哈萨克斯坦的德国族裔面临苏联时期的历史遗留问题
stories.sz: 哈萨克斯坦正努力应对苏联独裁统治的历史遗留问题。约85年前，斯大林驱逐了数十万人：约40万生活在苏联境内的德国族裔被送往哈萨克斯坦。

stories.t: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
stories.s: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.
stories.tz: 德国生活成本抗议活动演变成暴力事件，商店遭洗劫
stories.sz: 包括柏林、汉堡和法兰克福在内的德国各大城市爆发抗议活动，当天法国也举行了有数十万人参加的抗议。

stories.s: Cryptocurrency exchange says 90% of losses covered as FBI blames North Korean state-sponsored group TraderTraitor The cryptocurrency exchange Binance has started to allow its customers to withdraw their funds from the platform, as it…
